title: Savings Vault Balance Reduction on Pocketwire Personal Account Renewal Plan Fees
content:
Customers who keep money in a Pocketwire Savings Vault receive a reduction on the monthly renewal plan fee of their Pocketwire Personal Account.

The vault-saver reduction on the renewal plan fee reads the balance of the customer's active Pocketwire Savings Vault (a vault that is time-locked, frozen or closed does not count): at USD 10000.00 or more it is 10 percent, at USD 2500.00 or more but below 10000.00 it is 5 percent, and below 2500.00 or with no active vault it is 0 percent.

| Balance of the active Pocketwire Savings Vault (USD) | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 or more | 10 percent |
| 2500.00 up to 9999.99 | 5 percent |
| Below 2500.00 | 0 percent |
| No active vault (none held, or the vault is time-locked, frozen or closed) | 0 percent |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical balances)**

| Balance | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 9999.99 | 5 percent |
| 10000.00 | 10 percent |
| 2499.99 | 0 percent |
| 2500.00 | 5 percent |
| 12000.00 in a time-locked vault | 0 percent |
